reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch Re-Harden (mat_g1_na_q2_1), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The items directly assess counting by 2s, 5s, and 10s up to 100. For instance, counting by 2s is tested in "What number comes next when counting: 14, 16, 18, 20, ___?", counting by 5s is tested in "What number comes next when counting: 0, 5, 10, 15, ___?", and counting by 10s is tested in "What number comes next when counting: 0, 10, 20, 30, ___?".

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The sample packet thoroughly covers skip counting intervals of 2s, 5s, and 10s across multiple starting points and representations. Forward skip counting is tested in sequences like "What comes next: 30, 32, 34, 36, ___" and "What number comes next when counting: 10, 15, 20, 25, ___?", while backward counting is exercised in "What number comes next when counting backward: 25, 20, 15, 10, ___?".

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The difficulty and reading load are appropriate for Grade 1 Quarter 2 students. The sentence structures are concise and accessible, such as in pattern recognition ("What comes next: 22, 24, 26, 28, ___"), clear contextual phrasing ("Moses is counting forward by 2 starting from 26. The count is: 26, 28, 30, 32. What is the next number Moses should say?"), and simple visual queries ("What number is marked on the number line?").

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The generator demonstrates solid format variety, utilizing standard multiple-choice questions ("What number comes next when counting: 18, 20, 22, 24, ___?"), cloze / fill-in-the-blank items ("What comes next: 20, 30, 40, 50, ___"), visual number lines ("What number is marked on the number line?"), and word problem contexts ("Moses is counting forward by 2 starting from 26. The count is: 26, 28, 30, 32. What is the next number Moses should say?").

competency_alignment.rationale: All generated items align tightly with the target competency "Count by 2s, 5s and 10s up to 100" without introducing unintroduced mathematical concepts or operations. Items such as "What number comes next when counting: 20, 30, 40, 50, ___?" and "What number comes next when counting: 15, 20, 25, 30, ___?" assess skip counting directly.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All numbers used in the sequences and contexts are scaled strictly within whole numbers up to 100, such as group counting up to the boundary in "How many drinks are there in all?" and sequences reaching standard mid-range values like "What comes next: 20, 30, 40, 50, ___".
